_note: The TRES calibration lamps on the FLWO 60-inch: Alpaca switch/0 over a Pulizzi IPC power controller (docs/pulizzi.md).
Hardware is NOT allowed: allow_hardware stays false until every item under 'Confirm on the mountain' in docs/pulizzi.md is checked.
Then: allow_hardware true here AND --hardware on the command line, on the computer the unit's serial cable is plugged into.
port.device is a placeholder for that computer's serial device.
outlets: the lamp-to-outlet map from FLWO's legacy 60-inch software (ThAr1 2, ThAr2 7, Incand 4, Incand2 1); unconfirmed on the live system.
Outlets 3, 5, 6 and 8 are not lamps (their loads are unknown; 3 and 5 were seen on): they are not listed, so robofast never touches them.
max_on (s): placeholders, to be set from the lamps' rated duty and TRES practice; warm-up times are in flwo60.json (the sequencer's lamps entry).
rated_hours: UNCONFIRMED placeholders (typical of a hollow-cathode ThAr lamp and a quartz-halogen bulb), only for the life warnings; set from the installed lamps' data sheets.
Lamp hours are kept in <data directory>/lamp-hours/flwo60-lamps.json (hours_file; docs/pulizzi.md): set ROBOFAST_DATA_DIR (or an absolute hours_file) to a directory that is backed up, not a cache.
name: flwo60-lamps
